en: The image shows the address side of an old postal card printed in Russian with red pre‑printed text and lines, a red imperial double‑headed eagle emblem on the left, and handwritten address text in Latin script. A blue-green postage stamp at the upper right reads "EESTI POST" with a value of 15k and is cancelled with several circular postmarks that include the town name in Cyrillic and the date "15.2.19". The card is addressed to Tallinn (written in Latin script) and bears multiple postal markings.
